subject.title: feat(plugins): tool-name matchers scope tool hooks and Codex native hook relay spawns

question: Should exact tool-name matcher semantics become a supported public contract across plugin hooks, trusted tool policies, and agent tool-result middleware, including Codex alias and runtime-specific registration rules?
rationale: The proposed optional fields alter three public plugin-facing registration surfaces; the implementation can be repaired mechanically only after maintainers choose the permanent alias and runtime-identity semantics.

options.title: Approve a narrow matcher contract
options.body: Accept the API after shared alias canonicalization, runtime-specific scope storage, compatibility tests, and live Codex process proof are added.

options.title: Keep the optimization Codex-internal
options.body: Avoid expanding the public plugin API and pursue a narrower relay optimization until broader matcher semantics are deliberately designed.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow matcher contract
recommendation.body: Accept the API after shared alias canonicalization, runtime-specific scope storage, compatibility tests, and live Codex process proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: Their feature history most directly covers the relay lifecycle and fail-closed policy behavior affected by this contract choice.
